## v0.1.0.9000 (dev)

## v0.1.0 (2026-10-24)

Initial release. `tidydragen` is a [nemo][nemo] child package that parses and
tidies Illumina DRAGEN outputs into tidy tables, written to parquet, TSV, CSV,
RDS, or PostgreSQL.

- Pipelines:
  - DNA tumor-normal (somatic)
  - DNA germline-only
  - RNA tumor-only
  - ctTSO500
  - BCLConvert demultiplexing reports
  - Illumina InterOp run QC summaries
- One tool per output group: `DragenMap`, `DragenFqc`, `DragenCov`, `DragenVar`,
  `DragenRna`, `DragenTso`, `DragenBcl`, `Interop`);
- `Dragen` workflow runs all tools over a directory and ingests any matching
  patterns it detects
- Run as an R package, CLI (`tidydragen.R`), conda package, or multi-arch Docker
  image. See [Installation](installation.html) and
  [Quickstart](quickstart.html).

[nemo]: https://github.com/tidywf/nemo
